```{=html}
<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#1E2A4A;
    --navy-light:#2B3A61;
    --coral:#E8734A;
    --coral-light:#F2A184;
    --coral-tint:#FFF3EE;
    --paper:#F7F7F5;
    --ink:#232A3B;
    --muted:#767F94;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{height:100%;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
    background:#12182b;
    color:var(--ink);
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    min-height:100vh;
    padding:20px;
  }
  .deck{
    width:100%;
    max-width:980px;
    aspect-ratio:16/9;
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:14px;
    box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .deck-logo{
    position:absolute; top:16px; right:20px; z-index:5;
    background:#fff; padding:7px 14px; border-radius:9px;
    box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
    display:flex; align-items:center;
  }
  .deck-logo img{height:32px; display:block;}
  .slide{
    position:absolute;
    inset:0;
    padding:46px 62px;
    display:none;
    flex-direction:column;
    justify-content:center;
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateX(24px);
    transition:opacity .3s ease, transform .3s ease;
    overflow:auto;
  }
  .slide::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:5px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--coral) 0%, var(--coral-light) 100%);
  }
  .slide.title-slide::before{display:none;}
  .slide.active{display:flex; opacity:1; transform:translateX(0);}
  .kicker{
    font-size:11.5px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--coral); margin-bottom:9px;
  }
  h1{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif; font-size:44px; font-weight:800; margin:0 0 12px; color:var(--navy); line-height:1.12; letter-spacing:-.01em;}
  h2{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif; font-size:27px; font-weight:700; margin:0 0 18px; color:var(--navy);}
  h3{font-size:14px; margin:0 0 4px; color:var(--navy);}
  p.lede{font-size:15.5px; color:var(--muted); margin:0 0 6px; line-height:1.5;}
  p.note{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:10px;}

  .title-slide{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-light) 100%); color:#fff; position:relative;}
  .title-slide::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; right:-120px; top:-120px; width:420px; height:420px;
    border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(232,115,74,.16) 0%, rgba(232,115,74,0) 70%);
  }
  .title-slide h1{color:#fff; font-size:50px; font-weight:800;}
  .title-slide .accent{color:var(--coral-light);}
  .title-slide p.lede{color:#C7CCDA; font-size:17px;}
  .badge{margin-top:26px; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:#fff; letter-spacing:.01em;}
  .badge .sub{display:block; font-weight:400; font-size:12px; color:#9AA3BC; margin-top:2px;}
  .title-slide .deck-logo{background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);}

  .callout{border-radius:10px; padding:16px 20px; margin:14px 0;}
  .callout.navy{background:var(--navy); color:#fff;}
  .callout.navy .tag{color:var(--coral-light); font-weight:700; font-size:12px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; margin-bottom:6px;}
  .callout.navy p{margin:0; font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.5;}
  .callout.tint{background:var(--coral-tint); border-left:4px solid var(--coral);}
  .callout.tint .tag{color:var(--coral); font-weight:700; font-size:12px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; margin-bottom:6px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;}
  .callout.tint p{margin:0; font-size:14px; color:var(--ink); line-height:1.5;}

  .habit-list{list-style:none; margin:14px 0 0; padding:0;}
  .habit-list li{font-size:14px; color:var(--ink); padding:6px 0 6px 22px; position:relative;}
  .habit-list li::before{content:"—"; position:absolute; left:0; color:var(--coral);}

  .bigquestion{font-size:23px; font-weight:800; color:var(--navy); line-height:1.4; margin-top:22px; font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;}

  .bullets{list-style:none; margin:14px 0 0; padding:0;}
  .bullets li{font-size:15px; color:var(--ink); padding:7px 0 7px 24px; position:relative; line-height:1.4;}
  .bullets li::before{content:"•"; position:absolute; left:2px; color:var(--coral); font-size:18px; line-height:1;}

  .diagnose-grid{display:flex; gap:20px;}
  .diagnose-grid .left{flex:1;}
  .promptbox{background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E2E2DE; border-radius:10px; padding:16px 60px 16px 18px; font-size:14.5px; position:relative; line-height:1.5; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.03);}
  .promptbox.weak{border-left:4px solid var(--coral);}
  .promptbox.strong{border-left:4px solid var(--navy);}
  .copybtn{position:absolute; top:10px; right:10px; background:#fff; border:1px solid #DADAD4; border-radius:6px; padding:4px 9px; font-size:11px; cursor:pointer; color:var(--muted);}
  .copybtn:hover{background:#f0f0ec;}
  .copybtn.copied{background:var(--coral-tint); color:var(--coral); border-color:var(--coral);}
  .reveal-panel{flex:1; background:var(--paper); border-radius:10px; padding:16px 18px; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.03);}
  .reveal-panel.hidden ul{display:none;}
  .reveal-panel ul{margin:10px 0 0; padding-left:18px; font-size:13px; line-height:1.7; color:var(--ink);}
  .revealbtn{background:var(--navy); color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:8px; padding:9px 16px; font-size:12.5px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600;}
  .revealbtn:hover{background:var(--navy-light);}

  .cols5{display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:4px;}
  .card5{flex:1; background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E7E7E2; border-radius:10px; padding:14px 8px; text-align:center; opacity:0; transform:translateY(10px); animation:fadeUp .4s ease forwards; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.03);}
  .card5:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.05s;} .card5:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s;}
  .card5:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.25s;} .card5:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.35s;} .card5:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.45s;}
  .card5 .letter{font-family:Georgia,serif; font-size:28px; font-weight:700; color:var(--coral);}
  .card5 h3{font-size:13px; margin:5px 0 3px; font-weight:700;}
  .card5 p{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); margin:0; line-height:1.3;}
  @keyframes fadeUp{to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);}}

  .cols2{display:flex; gap:20px;}
  .cols2 .col{flex:1;}
  .col-label{font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:7px;}
  .col-label.weak{color:var(--coral);} .col-label.strong{color:var(--navy);}

  .flag-grid{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin-top:6px;}
  .flag{background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E7E7E2; border-left:3px solid var(--coral); border-radius:8px; padding:11px 14px; font-size:13px; color:var(--ink); flex:1 1 45%; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.03);}

  .grid4{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin-top:10px;}
  .miniblock{flex:1 1 21%; background:var(--paper); border-radius:8px; padding:10px 12px; font-size:12px; color:var(--ink); line-height:1.45; border:1px solid #E7E7E2; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.03);}
  .miniblock b{color:var(--navy); display:block; font-size:12.5px; margin-bottom:3px; font-weight:700;}

  .tabs{display:flex; gap:6px; margin-bottom:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .tabbtn{background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E2E2DE; border-radius:8px; padding:6px 11px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; color:var(--muted);}
  .tabbtn.active{background:var(--navy); color:#fff; border-color:var(--navy);}
  .tabpanel{display:none;}
  .tabpanel.active{display:block;}

  .checklist{list-style:none; margin:10px 0 0; padding:0;}
  .checklist li{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; font-size:13.5px; margin-bottom:9px; color:var(--ink); line-height:1.4;}
  .checklist .num{flex-shrink:0; width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--navy); color:#fff; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;}

  .disclaimer-grid{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; margin-top:16px;}
  .dcard{flex:1 1 29%; background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E7E7E2; border-radius:10px; padding:14px 16px; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.03);}
  .dcard .dot-row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .dcard .dot{width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0;}
  .dcard .model{font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--navy);}
  .dcard .disc{background:#fff; border:1px solid #ECECE8; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 10px; font-size:11px; color:#8a8f9c; line-height:1.4;}

  .pollgrid{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin-top:20px;}
  .pollcard{flex:1 1 21%; background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E7E7E2; border-radius:10px; padding:18px 10px; text-align:center; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.03);}
  .pollcard .name{font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--navy);}

  .navbar{width:100%; max-width:980px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-top:14px; color:#C7CCDA; font-size:12.5px;}
  .navbar .btns{display:flex; gap:8px;}
  .navbtn{background:#1c2440; border:1px solid #333d5c; color:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:7px 15px; font-size:12.5px; cursor:pointer;}
  .navbtn:hover{background:#2b3660;}
  .navbtn:disabled{opacity:.35; cursor:default;}
  .progress{font-size:11.5px; color:#8b93ad;}
</style>

<div class="deck" id="deck">

  <div class="deck-logo"><img src="eppslogo.png" alt="UTD EPPS logo"></div>

  <!-- 1: Title -->
  <div class="slide active title-slide">
    <div class="kicker">EPPS Math &amp; Coding Camp</div>
    <h1>AI Prompt<br><span class="accent">Engineering</span></h1>
    <p class="lede">Writing prompts that actually give the model what it needs.</p>
    <div class="badge">JP Adjadeh<span class="sub">EPPS, UT Dallas</span></div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <img src="check_in_form.png" alt="Attendance check-in QR code" style="width:220px; height:220px; display:block; margin:auto;">
  </div>


  <!-- 2: AI model check-in -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Before We Start</div>
    <h2>Which AI tool do you actually use?</h2>
    <p class="lede">Show of hands.</p>
    <div class="pollgrid">
      <div class="pollcard"><div class="name">ChatGPT</div></div>
      <div class="pollcard"><div class="name">Claude</div></div>
      <div class="pollcard"><div class="name">Gemini</div></div>
      <div class="pollcard"><div class="name">Comet AI</div></div>
      <div class="pollcard"><div class="name">Copilot</div></div>
      <div class="pollcard"><div class="name">Others</div></div>
      <div class="pollcard"><div class="name">I do not use AI at all</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 3: Can we trust AI -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">A Fair Question</div>
    <h2>Can we trust AI?</h2>
    <p class="lede">Every major AI tool tells you the same thing, right on its own screen.</p>
    <div class="disclaimer-grid">
      <div class="dcard"><div class="dot-row"><div class="dot" style="background:#10A37F;"></div><div class="model">ChatGPT</div></div><div class="disc">ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.</div></div>
      <div class="dcard"><div class="dot-row"><div class="dot" style="background:#D97757;"></div><div class="model">Claude</div></div><div class="disc">Claude can make mistakes. Please double-check responses.</div></div>
      <div class="dcard"><div class="dot-row"><div class="dot" style="background:#4285F4;"></div><div class="model">Gemini</div></div><div class="disc">Gemini can make mistakes, so double-check it.</div></div>
      <div class="dcard"><div class="dot-row"><div class="dot" style="background:#20808D;"></div><div class="model">Comet AI</div></div><div class="disc">Comet can make mistakes. Verify important information.</div></div>
      <div class="dcard"><div class="dot-row"><div class="dot" style="background:#0078D4;"></div><div class="model">Copilot</div></div><div class="disc">Copilot uses AI. Check for mistakes.</div></div>
      <div class="dcard"><div class="dot-row"><div class="dot" style="background:#1FB8CD;"></div><div class="model">Perplexity</div></div><div class="disc">Perplexity can make mistakes. Check important info.</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 4: Hallucination + open discussion -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">The Core Problem</div>
    <h2>Hallucination</h2>
    <ul class="bullets">
      <li>Fluent, confident answers can still be wrong</li>
      <li>Fabricated citations, invented numbers, plausible-looking errors</li>
      <li>No built-in signal that anything is off</li>
    </ul>
    <p class="bigquestion">Tell us about a time AI gave you a wrong answer — one that, once you fact-checked it, it admitted was wrong.</p>
  </div>

  <!-- 5: Human in the Loop -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">The Discipline That Resolves This</div>
    <h2>Human in the loop</h2>
    <p class="lede">Every issue just named traces back to one thing: the model generates, but nothing checks it unless you do.</p>
    <div class="callout navy">
      <div class="tag">The One Rule</div>
      <p>Never run or trust AI output you have not personally checked. If you can't verify it, don't rely on it yet.</p>
    </div>
    <ul class="habit-list">
      <li>Verify numbers by hand — recompute a statistic or spot-check a few rows</li>
      <li>Verify code by tracing it — running without an error is not the same as correct</li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <!-- 6: Example 1 -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Example 1</div>
    <h2>What's wrong with this prompt?</h2>
    <div class="diagnose-grid">
      <div class="left">
        <div class="promptbox weak" id="badprompt">I need to understand American democracy for a paper I'm writing.<button class="copybtn" onclick="copyText('badprompt', this)">Copy</button></div>
      </div>
      <div class="reveal-panel hidden" id="revealPanel1">
        <button class="revealbtn" onclick="showReveal('revealPanel1')">Reveal the diagnosis →</button>
        <ul>
          <li>No role — no lens to respond through</li>
          <li>No task — "understand" isn't a deliverable</li>
          <li>No context — "a paper" says nothing about the argument or angle</li>
          <li>No format — length, tone, structure all unset</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 7: Strong prompt side by side -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Same Ask, Rebuilt</div>
    <h2>Here's the same request, done well</h2>
    <div class="cols2">
      <div class="col">
        <div class="col-label weak">Weak</div>
        <div class="promptbox weak" style="font-size:13px;">I need to understand American democracy for a paper I'm writing.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="col">
        <div class="col-label strong">Strong</div>
        <div class="promptbox strong" style="font-size:13px;">You are a PhD student studying comparative political institutions. Explain how democratic accountability functions in the United States, focusing on the checks between the executive and legislative branches, and note one theoretical debate about how effective this mechanism actually is. Write this as a single analytical paragraph for a doctoral seminar audience, under 150 words.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="note">The weak prompt <em>sounds</em> like it has context — "a paper" — but tells the model nothing it can actually use.</p>
  </div>

  <!-- 8: R-T-C-F-E framework -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">The Framework</div>
    <h2>Five things the model can't guess on its own</h2>
    <div class="cols5">
      <div class="card5"><div class="letter">R</div><h3>Role</h3><p>Who should the model act as?</p></div>
      <div class="card5"><div class="letter">T</div><h3>Task</h3><p>One specific, concrete ask</p></div>
      <div class="card5"><div class="letter">C</div><h3>Context</h3><p>What it has no way of knowing</p></div>
      <div class="card5"><div class="letter">F</div><h3>Format</h3><p>Bullets, table, length, tone</p></div>
      <div class="card5"><div class="letter">E</div><h3>Examples</h3><p>A model output to imitate</p></div>
    </div>
    <p class="note">R–T–C–F–E. Every strong prompt today follows this shape — including the ones you'll write for R code this afternoon.</p>
  </div>

  <!-- 9: Discipline cards -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Same Problem, Your Field</div>
    <h2>Pick the card closest to your program</h2>
    <p class="lede">Each of these has the same gaps as Example 1 — "my data," "my research," "my paper" are gestured at but never described.</p>
    <div class="grid4">
      <div class="miniblock"><b>GIS</b>"I have some GIS data on land use — what should I do with it?"</div>
      <div class="miniblock"><b>Criminology</b>"I'm looking at crime data for my research — what does the data say?"</div>
      <div class="miniblock"><b>Economics</b>"I found this economic trend in my data — what does it mean?"</div>
      <div class="miniblock"><b>Political Science</b>"I need some background on political institutions for my paper."</div>
      <div class="miniblock"><b>Public Affairs &amp; Policy</b>"Can you help me with a policy memo / look at some policy data?"</div>
      <div class="miniblock"><b>Social Data Analytics</b>"I have some social media data — what can I do with it?"</div>
      <div class="miniblock"><b>Int'l Political Economy</b>"I need background on trade for my paper."</div>
    </div>
    <p class="note">Next: rebuild the one that's yours using R–T–C–F–E. Real topic, real dataset if you have one.</p>
  </div>

  <!-- 10: Exercise instructions -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Exercise 1</div>
    <h2>Run it weak, then run it strong</h2>
    <ul class="checklist">
      <li><div class="num">1</div><div>Run your field's weak prompt in your AI tool of choice. Look at what comes back.</div></li>
      <li><div class="num">2</div><div>Rebuild it using R–T–C–F–E, swapping in your own real topic or dataset.</div></li>
      <li><div class="num">3</div><div>Run the rebuilt version. Compare the two outputs side by side.</div></li>
      <li><div class="num">4</div><div>Note which single addition — role, task, context, format — changed the output the most.</div></li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <!-- 11: Live share -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Live Share</div>
    <h2>Show us your before / after</h2>
    <p class="lede" style="font-size:17px;">One volunteer per program. Project your screen and walk us through:</p>
    <ul class="checklist">
      <li><div class="num">1</div><div>The weak version you started with, and what it got wrong</div></li>
      <li><div class="num">2</div><div>Your rebuilt version</div></li>
      <li><div class="num">3</div><div>The one change that mattered most</div></li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <!-- 12: Answer key tabs -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Check Your Rebuild</div>
    <h2>Model answers, by field</h2>
    <div class="tabs">
      <button class="tabbtn active" onclick="showTab('gis', this)">GIS</button>
      <button class="tabbtn" onclick="showTab('crim', this)">Criminology</button>
      <button class="tabbtn" onclick="showTab('econ', this)">Economics</button>
      <button class="tabbtn" onclick="showTab('poli', this)">Poli Sci</button>
      <button class="tabbtn" onclick="showTab('pubaff', this)">Public Affairs</button>
      <button class="tabbtn" onclick="showTab('sdar', this)">Social Data</button>
      <button class="tabbtn" onclick="showTab('ipe', this)">IPE</button>
    </div>
    <div class="tabpanel active" id="tab-gis"><div class="promptbox strong" style="font-size:12.5px;">"You are a PhD student using GIS to study land-use change. I have parcel-level land-use data for a mid-sized U.S. county, 2010–2020. Suggest three exploratory spatial analyses (e.g., hot-spot mapping, density surfaces) that could reveal patterns of urban sprawl, and explain what each would show methodologically. Bullet points, under 200 words."</div></div>
    <div class="tabpanel" id="tab-crim"><div class="promptbox strong" style="font-size:12.5px;">"You are a PhD student in criminology analyzing city-level crime data. My dataset has monthly reported crime counts by offense type for one city, 2015–2023. Suggest three visualizations appropriate for detecting seasonal versus long-term trends, and note one limitation of each. Bullet points, under 200 words."</div></div>
    <div class="tabpanel" id="tab-econ"><div class="promptbox strong" style="font-size:12.5px;">"You are a PhD student in economics studying a trend in my dataset. My data shows quarterly unemployment and inflation for one country over 20 years, both rising together. Explain what that pattern suggests, and note two limitations of drawing conclusions from this data alone. Bullet points, under 200 words."</div></div>
    <div class="tabpanel" id="tab-poli"><div class="promptbox strong" style="font-size:12.5px;">"You are a PhD student in political science. I'm writing a paper comparing how presidential and parliamentary systems handle legislative gridlock. Summarize the key structural differences relevant to gridlock, formatted as a short comparison table."</div></div>
    <div class="tabpanel" id="tab-pubaff"><div class="promptbox strong" style="font-size:12.5px;">"You are a PhD student in public affairs writing a policy memo. My topic is the effect of state minimum-wage increases on small-business employment in a mid-sized U.S. metro. Draft the problem statement and three evidence-based options, each with one trade-off. Under 250 words, formal memo tone."</div></div>
    <div class="tabpanel" id="tab-sdar"><div class="promptbox strong" style="font-size:12.5px;">"You are a student in social data analytics analyzing social media data. My dataset is geotagged posts about a local election over one month. Suggest three text-based analyses (sentiment, topic, network) that would reveal patterns in public discourse, and note one validity concern with inferring public opinion from this kind of data. Bullet points, under 200 words."</div></div>
    <div class="tabpanel" id="tab-ipe"><div class="promptbox strong" style="font-size:12.5px;">"You are a student in international political economy. I'm writing a paper on how trade dependence affects a country's foreign policy alignment. Summarize the key theoretical mechanisms, formatted as a short comparison table of competing explanations, and note which has stronger empirical support in the literature."</div></div>
    <p class="note">Notice: every version still runs on the same five pieces — role, task, context, format, and an example where it helps.</p>
  </div>

  <!-- 13: Failure modes -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Watch For This</div>
    <h2>Common failure modes</h2>
    <div class="flag-grid">
      <div class="flag">Vague verbs — "help me with," "look at this"</div>
      <div class="flag">No role — model defaults to a generic assistant voice</div>
      <div class="flag">No constraints — leads to long, unfocused answers</div>
      <div class="flag">Assuming the model knows your dataset or field conventions</div>
      <div class="flag">"One-shotting" — trying to nail a complex task in a single try instead of refining turn by turn</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 14: Closing -->
  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Closing the Loop</div>
    <h2>Prompting well doesn't replace verifying</h2>
    <ul class="bullets">
      <li>A better prompt gets you a better first draft</li>
      <li>It does not get you a checked one — that part is still yours</li>
    </ul>
    <div class="callout navy">
      <div class="tag">Carry This Forward</div>
      <p>The same five-part discipline — role, task, context, format, example — applies to every prompt you write for R code today.</p>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<div class="navbar">
  <div class="progress" id="progress">1 / 14</div>
  <div class="btns">
    <button class="navbtn" id="prevBtn" onclick="go(-1)">Prev</button>
    <button class="navbtn" id="nextBtn" onclick="go(1)">Next</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
  let current = 0;

  function render(){
    slides.forEach((s, i) => s.classList.toggle('active', i === current));
    document.getElementById('prevBtn').disabled = current === 0;
    document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled = current === slides.length - 1;
    document.getElementById('progress').textContent = (current+1) + ' / ' + slides.length;
  }

  function go(delta){
    const next = current + delta;
    if(next >= 0 && next < slides.length){ current = next; render(); }
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if(e.key === 'ArrowRight') go(1);
    if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft') go(-1);
  });

  function showReveal(id){
    document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  function showTab(name, btn){
    const scope = btn.closest('.slide');
    scope.querySelectorAll('.tabpanel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
    scope.querySelectorAll('.tabbtn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    scope.querySelector('#tab-' + name).classList.add('active');
    btn.classList.add('active');
  }

  function copyText(id, btn){
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    const clone = el.cloneNode(true);
    const btnInClone = clone.querySelector('.copybtn');
    if(btnInClone) btnInClone.remove();
    const text = clone.textContent.trim();
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
      const original = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
      btn.classList.add('copied');
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = original; btn.classList.remove('copied'); }, 1400);
    });
  }

  render();
</script>
```
